detail: The method `wait_ready` may enter an infinite loop if `_read_some` always returns an empty byte string.

title: Potential infinite loop
detail: The method `wait_ready` may enter an infinite loop if `await self._parser.wait_ready()` always returns `False`.

title: Inverted Condition
detail: The condition `if self._parser.wait_ready()` is incorrect because `wait_ready` returns `True` if data is ready or if the stream is closed. This should be `if not self._parser.wait_ready()`.
note: Describes the planted negation and the fix.

title: Missing condition for whole digits
detail: The condition to check if whole digits are allowed was missing, causing incorrect patterns to be generated for cases where no whole digits are allowed.

title: Incorrect handling of zero with exponent
detail: The handling of zero with an exponent was incorrect, allowing positive exponents which would count as whole digits when none are allowed.

title: Missing test for cases where no whole digits are allowed
detail: The test suite did not include tests for cases where no whole digits are allowed, failing to catch patterns that incorrectly accepted bare integers.

title: Missing check for widget attachment
detail: The code does not check if the widgets are attached before attempting to get their common ancestor, which can lead to a crash if they are not attached.
note: On the planted line, but asks for a check that's there, instead of seeing `and` for `or`.

title: Missing default argument in get_common_ancestor method
detail: The get_common_ancestor method does not have a default argument, which can cause a crash if no common ancestor is found and the method is called without a default.

title: Handling Zero-Width Characters
detail: The code does not handle zero-width characters correctly, which can lead to an infinite loop. Specifically, when a zero-width character (like a zero-width joiner or variation selector) is encountered without any previous characters, the code does not correctly handle this case.
